name: yama6a/subtitle-toolbox-php
description: A PHP library and command line tool that reads, edits and writes subtitles, transcripts and chapter lists in more than 30 formats.

suggest.ext-curl: for DeepLEngine, GoogleTranslateEngine and the translate command
suggest.ext-zlib: to decode PNG images, which PgsFormatter needs, to compress PNG images and to read zlib-compressed MKV tracks
suggest.yama6a/php-glyph-ocr: ^0.3, for GlyphOcrEngine, the pure PHP OCR of PGS and VobSub image cues where Tesseract is not installed
